field.label: NextDNS profile ID (quick-add)
field.help: Paste just the NextDNS profile ID (e.g. abc123) and the type/endpoint fields below are filled in automatically as https://dns.nextdns.io/<id> with type doh3. Leave blank for a non-NextDNS upstream.

field.label: Endpoint
field.help: URL for doh/doh3, host[:port] for dot/legacy.
